UserPromptSubmit.description: Surface newly-tapped status-board answers into context. The board records answers server-side and notifies nobody; relying on the agent to remember to read the file failed within an hour of the rule being written. Durable but slow: it can only fire when the owner sends a message, so a tap waits for their next prompt. That latency is what SessionStart's arm-watcher removes — keep both, they fail differently.

SessionStart.description: Instruct the agent to arm the answer watcher, so a tap arrives in seconds rather than on the owner's next message. Silent for projects with no board. A hook cannot call the Monitor tool, so this is a reliably-delivered instruction rather than a mechanism — weaker than board-answers.py by design, and the strongest option available for something that requires a tool call.
